description.narrative: The purpose of this project is to continue with the scarlet macaw (SM) reintroduction and conservation efforts in Los Tuxtlas Biosphere Reserve, Veracruz. The main objective is to continue with the establishment a new population of SM and to use this species as an ambassador for native species recovery, habitat restoration, and human wellbeing. This project aims at reducing the threats of habitat loss and poaching for the illegal trade affecting the SM and other native species. Project activities include: (1) release into the wild another group of SMs; (2) continue monitoring and supporting all SMs released during Phase I of the project (100 individuals); (3) successfully reintroduce the native red-eyed tree frog to Reserva Ecolgica Nanciyaga; (4) create sustainable livelihoods alternatives for the local communities to the establishment of small scale meliponine (stingless bees) beekeeping enterprises ; (5) improve SM habitat quality and connectivity by continuing to carry out reforestation efforts with native tree species; and (6) establish a pilot agouti (Dasyprocta mexicana) farm as an alternative protein and economic alternative to cattle and to reduce the pressure out of the dwindling wild population of agoutis in the area..The goal of this project is to conserve 686,767 acres of coral reefs in six Natural Protected Areas (NPAs) of the Mexican Pacific. The objective is to improve the management of coral reefs to reduce threats from uncontrolled touristic activities.
